definition.@EndUserText.label: View 1
definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT 
    b."BATCH_ID",
    CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
    'HIST_RAW' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
    o."SOURCE_FILE",
    "d"."PRCTR","d"."DATBI","d"."KOKRS","d"."DATAB","d"."ERSDA","d"."USNAM","d"."MERKMAL","d"."ABTEI","d"."VERAK","d"."VERAK_USER","d"."WAERS","d"."NPRCTR","d"."LAND1","d"."ANRED","d"."NAME1","d"."NAME2","d"."NAME3","d"."NAME4","d"."ORT01","d"."ORT02","d"."STRAS","d"."PFACH","d"."PSTLZ","d"."PSTL2","d"."SPRAS","d"."TELBX","d"."TELF1","d"."TELF2","d"."TELFX","d"."TELTX","d"."TELX1","d"."DATLT","d"."DRNAM","d"."KHINR","d"."BUKRS","d"."VNAME","d"."RECID","d"."ETYPE","d"."TXJCD","d"."REGIO","d"."KVEWE","d"."KAPPL","d"."KALSM","d"."LOGSYSTEM","d"."LOCK_IND","d"."PCA_TEMPLATE","d"."SEGMENT","d"."KTEXT","d"."LTEXT","d"."MCTXT"
FROM "1_INBOUND_HIST_RAW.1LT_CEPC_HIST_RAW" d
	CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_HIST_RAW_01" b
	JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o 
	    ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID" 
	        AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'HIST_RAW' 
	        AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'CEPC'
